blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Zone of Accumulation is where total snowfall exceeds glacial melting.
The Zone of Ablation is characterized by melting exceeding snowfall.
The Equilibrium Line forms the dividing boundary between accumulation and ablation zones.
Crevasses are deep cracks that develop within a glacier due to stress.
The Glacial Tongue refers to the projecting extension of a glacier.

blocks.content: • Zone of Ablation – melting exceeds snowfall.
• Equilibrium Line – boundary between accumulation and ablation zones.

items: Distinguish clearly between the Zone of Accumulation (snowfall exceeds melting) and the Zone of Ablation (melting exceeds snowfall).
Identify the Equilibrium Line as the exact boundary separating the accumulation and ablation zones.
Remember that deep cracks caused by internal stress are specifically termed Crevasses.

blocks.content: • Crevasses – deep cracks due to stress.
• Glacial Tongue – projecting part of glacier.
